content: eBay keyset creation: sign in to Developer Program account, go to Application Keys page, enter application name, click 'Create a keyset' under Sandbox or Production, confirm primary contact info, receive App ID/Dev ID/Cert ID. Sandbox keys required before sandbox calls work; Production keys are separate and won't work in Sandbox. Must subscribe to or opt out of marketplace account deletion/closure notifications before Production keyset can be used.
